An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
